scenes.headline: How CSFM gives flow matching a better start
scenes.sub: A learned, caption-shaped source instead of fixed Gaussian noise.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Mireille! Flow matching learns to carry noise into a picture. CSFM changes where that noise starts, and the whole thing trains faster. Here's how.

scenes.text: Flow matching never required a Gaussian source. CSFM learns a caption-dependent source, so samples start near their target and the paths cross far less.
scenes.say: Flow matching never required the source to be Gaussian noise. CSFM learns it from the caption, so each sample starts right beside the picture it is meant to become.

steps.say: The usual way sends every caption out of one shared Gaussian far from the data. The transport paths tangle and cross.
CSFM reads the caption and puts the source right next to its target. Now the paths run almost straight across.

scenes.title: Why a better start helps
scenes.say: The flow matching loss splits in two.

parts.note: the model's job; shrinks as it trains
parts.say: One part is the model's job, and it shrinks as the network trains.

parts.note: path ambiguity; zero only when paths never cross
parts.say: The other is path ambiguity. No amount of training removes it. It is set only by where the samples start, and it is zero only when the paths never cross.

scenes.title: FID on captioned ImageNet, lower is better
scenes.note: RAE latents, fifty-step Euler, no guidance
scenes.say: A fixed Gaussian source scores three point oh four. Regularizing only the variance drops it. Adding directional alignment reaches two point four five, the best score.

scenes.label: faster FID convergence in structured latents

steps.say: Here is quality against the number of sampling steps. CSFM, in purple, stays below standard flow matching.
After one round of reflow, cutting fifty steps to two costs CSFM about three and a half, where standard flow matching loses almost twelve.

scenes.text: The source is a design choice, not a constant. Place it by the caption, keep its spread, and flow matching converges faster.

recap: The source need not be Gaussian
Learn it per caption to cut crossings
scenes.say: To recap: the source need not be Gaussian, learning it per caption cuts the path crossings, and convergence is up to three times faster.
